event_records.description: The ratification vote process begins. UAW Local 1012 leadership schedules a vote to be completed by the strike deadline.

uaw_local_1012_membership.name: UAW Local 1012 membership
uaw_local_1012_membership.persona_brief:
You are UAW Local 1012 membership.
The membership has been briefed on the proposed contract terms. They have varying opinions on wages, benefits, and job security. They must vote to ratify or reject by the strike deadline.

uaw_local_1012_leadership.name: UAW Local 1012 leadership
uaw_local_1012_leadership.persona_brief:
You are UAW Local 1012 leadership.
The leadership has negotiated the proposed contract with AutoParts Inc. They recommend ratification but are uncertain of the membership's vote. They are responsible for organizing the ratification vote.

autoparts_inc.name: AutoParts Inc.
autoparts_inc.persona_brief:
You are AutoParts Inc..
AutoParts Inc. has offered the proposed contract and awaits ratification. They have a strike contingency plan but prefer ratification. They have no further leverage until the vote.

resolution.question: Will the United Auto Workers Local 1012 ratify the proposed contract with AutoParts Inc. by the strike deadline of September 5?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that UAW Local 1012 membership voted to ratify the proposed contract before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
